text: How many of those are whole-genome sequencing rather than RNA-Seq?

To make sure I count the right set of records, could you clarify what “those” refers to?  
For example:  
• Which organism, project, or study are we talking about?  
• Are you referring to a list of sequencing runs we retrieved earlier (e.g., from ENA or SRA), or to something else?  
Once I know exactly which set of records you have in mind, I can look up how many are whole-genome sequencing (WGS) versus RNA-Seq.
